title: Fluent Emoji — material changes, semantic form persists
summary: Use layered light and material to enrich an original semantic symbol while retaining its meaning across flat and one-colour renditions.
use_when: A labelled reaction or occasional completion message benefits from a small expressive symbol.
avoid_when: A symbol would become the sole status source, imply an unverified outcome or obstruct recovery.
